decision.reason: The dependency-neutral policy is reviewed, but an on-game-PC WFP/ExitLag ordering canary and remaining activation gates are not proven.

packaging_requirements: ship the upstream LICENSE and copyright notices
identify the exact upstream source tag and offer corresponding source as required

platform.driver_install_policy: explicit-user-enabled setup or elevated helper; never silently enabled by Automarkers

handles.capability: passive SYN, ACK, tuple, loopback, impostor, and checksum-path evidence
PID and five-tuple flow events; misses flows established before handle open
existing and future WinDivert handle inventory; cannot inventory arbitrary non-WinDivert WFP callouts

handles.filter_template: outbound and ip and tcp and tcp.PayloadLength > 0 and ip.SrcAddr == <local-ip> and tcp.SrcPort == <local-port> and ip.DstAddr == <remote-ip> and tcp.DstPort == <remote-port>
handles.capability: divert one exact outbound IPv4/TCP payload leg and reinject original-or-rewritten packets

packet_contract.checksum_policy: recalculate IPv4 and TCP checksums after any change and update WINDIVERT_ADDRESS checksum flags; pass through an unchanged received packet/address pair without inventing checksum validity
packet_contract.loopback_policy: do not exclude loopback; bind only an exact process-owned tuple and record the Loopback flag
packet_contract.impostor_policy: do not exclude or clear Impostor during discovery; refuse activation until the authoritative ExitLag leg and WFP ordering are proven
packet_contract.fragment_policy: do not set FRAGMENTS and reject any fragmented outbound carrier
packet_contract.send_length_policy: require sent length to equal received length exactly
packet_contract.per_packet_failure_policy: synchronously reinject the original packet; if original reinjection fails, stop receiving and close immediately

queue_policy.rule: read back every configured value; do not increase before measured load testing; any observed queue loss disables placement for the epoch

shutdown_policy: call WinDivertShutdown(RECV), never BOTH while diverted originals remain
drain queued packets until ERROR_NO_DATA and synchronously reinject each original-or-verified rewrite
clear the TCP rewrite ledger and exact epoch binding
known_residual_risks: NETWORK packets do not carry PID, so ownership is necessarily correlated across FLOW/IP Helper/SYN evidence and has a process-termination race
queue or internal work-queue exhaustion can drop packets
a packet already returned to user mode can be lost if the process terminates before reinjection
two block-clone-reinject WFP drivers can create mutual loops ending in ERROR_HOST_UNREACHABLE
WinDivert priority orders WinDivert handles but does not prove ordering against ExitLag or arbitrary WFP providers
server acceptance, anti-cheat response, and far-coordinate authorization are not established by wire conservation

exitlag_decision.reason: No official WinDivert or Microsoft contract can establish the relative callout order or plaintext leg used by ExitLag.
required_evidence: run on the game computer, not a mirrored capture computer
observe exactly one process-owned candidate leg with ExitLag off
observe exactly one process-owned candidate leg with ExitLag on
prove which leg contains the exact BPSR request before any diverting handle is opened
run an explicit short passthrough-only canary and reject loops, duplicate observations, TTL decay, send errors, queue loss, or connection reset
persist the ExitLag setting as opt-in and bind the evidence to the connection epoch
